title: /health disagrees with the API reference
seededDefect: variant of DEFECT 3: handlers/health.ts via lib/format.ts
goal: Make the GET /health response agree with docs/api.md.

approvedRules.title: Keep the public response format
approvedRules.content: Every endpoint answers { data } or { error: { code, message } }. Never add, rename, or remove top-level response fields, and never return an empty body.

approvedRules.title: Use the shared validators
approvedRules.content: Validate request input with the helpers in src/lib/validate.ts and reply 400 VALIDATION_FAILED on bad input.

acceptance: Every field of the /health payload has the unit and meaning docs/api.md gives it
Field names and the { data } envelope are unchanged
Other callers of any changed helper keep a consistent unit (or are updated with it)
